original.target_description: Located original Study 1: Time 1 mood measures and three coping factors in Structural Model 1, Table 2, printed p. 995 / PDF p. 7; supplied target does not uniquely identify a predictor/outcome/test.

replication.target_description: Unassigned side; not inspected in this original-only blind validation.

notes: Published article title and authors match the supplied reference. PDF page 7 (printed p. 995), Table 2, visually checked against the supplied scan. The table is titled "Standardized Parameter Estimates of Structural Model 1: Paths From the Personality Predispositions to the Coping Factors". Its three outcome columns are "Avoidant Coping", "Active Coping", and "Seeking Support". These are standardized structural-model path estimates, not printed Pearson r values. The supplied locator does not specify which coping factor or test to select. No coefficient was selected or converted. Contextual sample only: printed p. 992, Response Rates, states "The final sample for the analysis of coping and psychological adjustment consisted of 672 respondents who had completed both questionnaires"; student identification numbers were verified, two incomplete/improper Time 2 questionnaires were dropped, and missing scale/item values were imputed as described in Analysis. This sample cannot establish a uniquely specified target test. Source text: /home/lukas/.t3/worktrees/fred-data/audit-fred-stats-2026-10/audit/fred_stats_2026-10/texts/followup_mac_b9278a81662a16a18732b789.txt; numerical visual check: /home/lukas/work/fred-mac-recovery-20261030/private_batch_01/artifacts/b9278a81662a16a18732b789_ebsco_psycinfo.pdf. The target names extraversion, but the methods (printed p. 991, Time 1 Instruments) describe positive and negative mood assessed with the Affects Balance Scale, not an extraversion instrument. Table 2 has a "Positive mood" row with candidate entries ".06", ".26***", and ".27***" across the three coping columns. Positive mood was not silently relabeled extraversion. Neither the predictor mapping nor the outcome/test is uniquely established by the supplied description and p. 7 locator. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
